messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Need help with simple plot
parts:
Reading between the lines, is this (approximately) what you want?

A toy reproducible example:

DF <- data.frame( x1 = rnorm(10),
x2 = rnorm(10, m = 1),
x3 = rnorm(10, m = 2, s = 2),
x4 = rnorm(10, m = 3, s = 1.5),
x5 = rnorm(10, m = -1)
)

# Separate line 1 from the rest
DF1 <- DF[1, ]
DF0 <- DF[-1, ]

library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)

# The useful melt() function at work:
DFm1 <- melt(DF1)
str(DFm1)
DFm0 <- melt(DF0)

# The strip plots:
ggplot(DFm0, aes(x = variable, y = value)) +
geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.05)) +
geom_point(data = DFm1, color = "red", size = 2.5)

If you wanted something different, then (as Ista suggested) provide a
reproducible example and a clear explanation of what you want.

Dennis
